title: Login page elements are present
expected_result: Username, password, Login, Register and recovery controls are visible

expected_result: Login is rejected with clear feedback; session is not created

title: Login with documented demo credentials
expected_result: Authenticated account overview opens

title: Required fields validation
expected_result: Mandatory fields are identified; account is not created

title: Password confirmation mismatch
steps: Enter different password and confirmation; submit
expected_result: Validation prevents registration

title: Account overview after login
expected_result: Only accounts belonging to authenticated customer are listed

steps: Open transfer; choose source/target; enter positive amount; submit once
expected_result: Transfer succeeds once; balances/transaction history reflect amount

title: Reject zero transfer amount
expected_result: Validation rejects transfer and balances remain unchanged

title: Reject negative transfer amount
expected_result: Validation rejects transfer and balances remain unchanged

title: Prevent accidental duplicate transfer
expected_result: System should not unintentionally create duplicate money movement

title: Bill payment mandatory fields
steps: Open bill pay; omit payee/account fields; submit
expected_result: Missing fields are reported; no payment is created

title: Account history displays latest transaction
expected_result: Transfer transaction is visible with expected amount/type/date

title: Update contact details
steps: Open profile; edit allowed contact field; save; reload
expected_result: Updated value persists and unrelated fields remain unchanged

title: Loan request with valid positive values
expected_result: A loan response is shown with decision details

title: Login endpoint valid credentials
expected_result: HTTP 200; customer payload returned

title: Login endpoint invalid credentials
expected_result: Non-success or explicit authentication failure response; no customer data leakage

title: Get account by valid ID
expected_result: HTTP 200; response contains account id, customer id, type and balance

title: Get account with unknown ID
expected_result: Clear not-found/error response; no unrelated account returned

title: Get customer accounts
expected_result: HTTP 200; list contains only customer accounts

title: Get transactions for account
expected_result: HTTP 200; list structure is valid and account-consistent

title: Filter transactions by amount
expected_result: Returned transactions match requested amount

title: Filter transactions by date range
expected_result: All returned transaction dates are inside range

title: Transfer valid positive amount
expected_result: Success response; source/target balances and history reflect one transfer

title: Reject invalid source account
expected_result: Operation fails; target balance is unchanged

title: Reject non-positive amount
expected_result: Operation rejected; no transaction created

title: Request loan with valid parameters
expected_result: LoanResponse schema returned; decision fields present

expected_result: Validation/error response; existing valid data remains intact

title: Content type and response schema
expected_result: Response content type matches documented format and required fields are present

title: Keyboard navigation on login
steps: Navigate interactive controls using keyboard only
expected_result: Focus reaches controls in logical order and focus is visible

title: Form labels associated with inputs
expected_result: Each input has a meaningful accessible label

title: Error message understandable without color only
expected_result: Error is conveyed by text/semantics, not color alone

title: Mobile viewport basic usability
steps: Open login and core forms at narrow viewport
expected_result: No essential control is clipped; fields remain usable

steps: Search logs by correlationId; follow request events

steps: Correlate ticket data with logs and expected test case
